theorem real_second_moment_integrable (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : 0 < t) :
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x^2 * realKernel m hm t ht x)

theorem real_second_moment (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : 0 < t) :
    ∫ x : ℝ, x^2 * realKernel m (by omega) t ht x = 0

theorem not_nonnegative_ae (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : 0 < t) :
    ¬ ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, 0 ≤ realKernel m (by omega) t ht x

theorem exists_negative (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : 0 < t) :
    ∃ x : ℝ, realKernel m (by omega) t ht x < 0

theorem norm_integral_gt_one (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : 0 < t) :
    1 < ∫ x : ℝ, ‖realKernel m (by omega) t ht x‖

theorem symbol_scaling (m : ℕ) (t c : ℝ≥0) (x : ℝ) :
    HigherHeatL2.symbol m (t*c^(2*m)) x = HigherHeatL2.symbol m t ((c : ℝ)*x)

theorem kernel_scaling (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (t c : ℝ≥0)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hc : 0 < c) (x : ℝ) :
    evenKernel m hm (t*c^(2*m)) (mul_pos ht (pow_pos hc _)) x =
      (c : ℝ)⁻¹ • evenKernel m hm t ht (x/(c : ℝ))

theorem realKernel_scaling (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (t c : ℝ≥0)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hc : 0 < c) (x : ℝ) :
    realKernel m hm (t*c^(2*m)) (mul_pos ht (pow_pos hc _)) x =
      (c : ℝ)⁻¹ * realKernel m hm t ht (x/(c : ℝ))

theorem norm_integral_scaling (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (t c : ℝ≥0)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hc : 0 < c) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, ‖realKernel m hm (t*c^(2*m)) (mul_pos ht (pow_pos hc _)) x‖) =
      ∫ x : ℝ, ‖realKernel m hm t ht x‖

theorem realKernel_coe (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : 0 < t) (x : ℝ) :
    (realKernel m hm t ht x : ℂ) = evenKernel m hm t ht x

theorem realKernel_integral (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : 0 < t) :
    ∫ x, realKernel m hm t ht x = 1

theorem incrementLaw_mass (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (t : ι → ℝ≥0) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i) :
    incrementLaw m hm t ht Set.univ = 1

theorem incrementLaw_variation (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (t : ι → ℝ≥0) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i) :
    (incrementLaw m hm t ht).variation =
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : ι => volume)).withDensity
        (fun x => ‖incrementDensity m hm t ht x‖ₑ)

theorem incrementLaw_variation_mass (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (t : ι → ℝ≥0) (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i) :
    ((incrementLaw m hm t ht).variation Set.univ).toReal =
      ∏ i, ∫ x, ‖realKernel m hm (t i) (ht i) x‖

theorem variation_mass_map_le {Ω X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace X]
    (μ : SignedMeasure Ω) (f : Ω → X) (hf : Measurable f) :
    ((μ.map f).variation Set.univ).toReal ≤ (μ.variation Set.univ).toReal

theorem no_signed_increment_realization {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : 0 < t)
    (μ : SignedMeasure Ω) (observation : (n : ℕ) → Ω → (Fin n → ℝ))
    (hobs : ∀ n, Measurable (observation n))
    (hlaw : ∀ n, μ.map (observation n) =
      incrementLaw m (by omega) (fun _ : Fin n => t) (fun _ => ht)) : False

theorem no_signed_path_law (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : 0 < t)

      incrementLaw m (by omega) (fun _ : Fin n => t) (fun _ => ht)) : False

theorem square_sum_integrable (p : ℕ) :
    (incrementLaw 2 (by norm_num) t ht).Integrable (fun x => (powerSum p x)^2)

theorem quartic_sum_second_moment :
    (∫ᵛ x, (powerSum 4 x)^2 ∂<•incrementLaw 2 (by norm_num) t ht) =
      576*(∑ i, ((t i : ℝ) : ℂ))^2 + 19584*∑ i, ((t i : ℝ) : ℂ)^2

theorem centered_quartic_second_moment :
    (∫ᵛ x, (powerSum 4 x + 24*(∑ i, ((t i : ℝ) : ℂ)))^2
      ∂<•incrementLaw 2 (by norm_num) t ht) = 19584*∑ i, ((t i : ℝ) : ℂ)^2
theorem duration_pos (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) (n : ℕ) : 0 < duration T n

theorem duration_coe (T : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ) :
    (duration T n : ℝ) = (T : ℝ)/(n+1 : ℕ)

theorem durations_sum (T : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ _ : Fin (n+1), ((duration T n : ℝ) : ℂ)) = ((T : ℝ) : ℂ)

theorem durations_square_sum (T : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ _ : Fin (n+1), ((duration T n : ℝ) : ℂ)^2) =
      ((T : ℝ) : ℂ)^2 / (n+1 : ℕ)

theorem quadratic_second_moment (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ᵛ x, (powerSum 2 x)^2 ∂<•law T hT n) = -24*((T : ℝ) : ℂ)

theorem quartic_mean (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ᵛ x, powerSum 4 x ∂<•law T hT n) = -24*((T : ℝ) : ℂ)

theorem centered_quartic_second_moment (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ᵛ x, (powerSum 4 x + 24*((T : ℝ) : ℂ))^2 ∂<•law T hT n) =
      19584*((T : ℝ) : ℂ)^2 / (n+1 : ℕ)

theorem centered_quartic_second_moment_tendsto (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫ᵛ x, (powerSum 4 x + 24*((T : ℝ) : ℂ))^2 ∂<•law T hT n)
      atTop (𝓝 0)

theorem error_integrable (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) (n : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun x => ‖powerSum 4 x + 24*((T : ℝ) : ℂ)‖^2) (law T hT n).variation

theorem centered_norm_lower (T : ℝ≥0) {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (x : ι → ℝ) :
    24*(T : ℝ) ≤ ‖powerSum 4 x + 24*((T : ℝ) : ℂ)‖

theorem variation_mass (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) (n : ℕ) :
    ((law T hT n).variation Set.univ).toReal =
      (∫ x : ℝ, ‖realKernel 2 (by norm_num) T hT x‖)^(n+1)

theorem absoluteError_lower (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) (n : ℕ) :
    576*(T : ℝ)^2 * (∫ x : ℝ, ‖realKernel 2 (by norm_num) T hT x‖)^(n+1) ≤
      absoluteError T hT n

theorem absoluteError_tendsto (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) :
    Tendsto (absoluteError T hT) atTop atTop

theorem spike_clock (m : ℕ) [Fact (0 < m)] (n : ℕ) :
    (clock m (spike m n) : ℝ) = (((n : ℝ)+1)^4)⁻¹ * ((n : ℝ)+1)^(2*m)

theorem spike_l2_norm (n : ℕ) : ‖spike 1 n‖ = 1 / ((n : ℝ)+1)
theorem spike_l2_tendsto : Tendsto (spike 1) atTop (𝓝 0)

theorem spike_fourier (n : ℕ) (ξ : ℝ) :
    (∫ᵛ y, HigherHeatCylinderFourier.phase ξ y ∂<•marginal 2 (spike 2 n)) =
      HigherHeatL2.symbol 2 1 ξ

    (h0 : F 0 = 1)
    (hs : ∀ n, F (spike 1 n) =
      ∫ᵛ y, HigherHeatCylinderFourier.phase 1 y ∂<•marginal 2 (spike 2 n)) :

theorem firstChannel_terminal_zero (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 < m) (T : ℝ≥0)
    (A : Field timeMeasure) : firstChannel m T A (core terminalCylinder) = 0

theorem witness_centered (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) :
    mean m hm T hT (core (terminalCylinder^(2*m-1))) = 0

theorem witness_pairing (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T) :
    pairing m hm T hT (core (terminalCylinder^(2*m-1))) (core terminalCylinder) =
      ((2*m).factorial:ℝ)*((-1:ℝ)^(m+1)*(T:ℝ))

theorem no_firstChannel_representation (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 < m) (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : 0 < T)
    (A : Field timeMeasure) :
    firstChannel m T A ≠
      pairing m (by omega) T hT (core (terminalCylinder^(2*m-1)))

human_reorganization: The fixed-horizon finite-variation path-law obstruction is proved directly from exact kernel scaling and variation contraction. The named formal path-law result uses arbitrarily many fixed-step increments and increasing horizons; these are not conflated.

The signed quartic square cancellation is not an L2 norm limit: its actual absolute-variation error diverges. Normalized variation probabilities still have pointwise distance at least 24T from the proposed negative limit.

The explicit L2-small deterministic spike has constant fourth-power clock. Angular-frequency value exp(-1) corresponds to the formal 2pi-frequency convention after rescaling; no continuity claim on the stronger factorial domain is refuted.

The final complementary-derivative channel is necessary for the displayed terminal test by a direct derivative calculation. The named source proves first-channel range failure; no general channel minimality or synthesis injectivity is inferred.

Section 3 gives the elementary factorial-series reconstruction of the faithful one-coordinate realization. Every derivative at zero is an ell1 coefficient. Actual integer-order arithmetic theta moments have the lower bound d*4^n from the fixed positive interval [2,3], so they cannot be realized in this coefficient domain. The actual real/complex derivative bridge and nonmembership theorem are mapped. This does not assert nonrepresentability in every multivariate quotient, injectivity of the completed product pairing, a failure of the scoped signed reconstruction, or a zero/threshold/RH implication. The coefficient-growth test is elementary and is not claimed novel.
